notes: Only small yellow lightning glyphs in y250...650 are retained. Static header art, instruction-panel illustrations, key lime and reward coins are excluded.
Coin tracks are excluded with4px expanded radius; key bounds use2px expansion. Large raw yellow/lime components are rejected before gating so cut key/coin rims cannot become fake sparks.
Orange body/eye masking removes yellow antialias fringe from the white smile. Pink body is not expanded because real sparks sit close to its tail.
Glyph contours use local background/color unmixing,4x subpixel isocontours and0.22px polygon simplification. No glow field is included.
Source median fill is measured from strong foreground pixels. Per-glyph opacity is a color-unmix estimate; sourceMedianRGB is supplied for inspection, not another independent opacity factor.

Faint endpoint frames are searched for at most2frames using neighboring location; their retained outlines/opacity still come from actual source pixels. Fragments below~.15 opacity or2pixels are omitted.
One isolated2x3px yellow-brown key/hand blend at source frame290 was rejected by temporal consistency; it is not a lightning glyph.
No independent visible lightning was detected in the repeat presses within the requested y-range after exclusions. Do not manufacture repeat bursts.
Geometry/color at this3–12px scale is limited by source video compression. Faint endpoint confidence is lower.
